Which statement about elements in Group VIII of the Periodic Table is correct?
A
They all have a full outer shell of electrons.
B
They all react with Group I elements to form ionic compounds.
C
They are all diatomic molecules.
D
They are all liquids at room temperature and pressure.

options.label: A
options.text: They all have a full outer shell of electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: They all react with Group I elements to form ionic compounds.

options.label: D
options.text: They are all liquids at room temperature and pressure.
